entries.title: Static Branch-Antlered Deer
entries.description: One original complete static stylized antlered deer: a long continuous tapered torso carried by four narrow joint-shaped legs with full flat dark hoof soles, an ascending long neck supporting a small cheeked head and tapered muzzle with integral nose, two outward pointed thick ears, a short tapered tail, and two complete thick branching antlers. Each antler is one continuous closed branched solid with a rising beam and three distinct offshoot tines. Eyes, inner ears, nose and hooves are integral face materials. Thirteen closed editable meshes meet at twelve complete finite planar joints. Four full ground soles, entire finite material domains, antler clefts, leg spaces and all noncontact pairs are tested against the exported geometry. Five opaque matte constant PBR colors. Metres, native Z up, front -Y, ground origin horizontally bounds centred. One prop, zero scenes or variants. Entire animal geometry is newly authored; no rabbit, tortoise, bird or carousel-horse geometry reused. No fur, textures, separate eyes, clothing, pedestal, vegetation, rig, skeleton or animation. Fixed artistic appearance only; no real species identification, anatomical or biological precision, ecology, animal behaviour, locomotion, physical stability, manufacturing, safety or old-asset compatibility claim.
